title: PyroWave 4:4:4 Haar — Quest Pro (experimental)

headset_settings.render_resolution: OpenXR recommended; stream scale and foveation from client

notice: Experimental GPU Haar 4:4:4. Desktop bitrate: 400 Mbit/s (editable below). Headset: PyroWave, 90 Hz, 8-bit. Foveation and stream scale follow the client, including gaze tracking and its center settings. The desktop foveation override is optional and requires a WiVRn restart. Measured 85–88 fresh frames/s on 5 GHz without foveation; sustained 90 Hz and Wi-Fi 6E remain unqualified.
notes: Matching client/server required. GPU compute decoding; preserves full chroma.
Quest Pro OpenXR recommendation 1440x1584 per eye; encoded dimensions follow client foveation and are rounded to 64-pixel blocks.
Keeps existing host application, tracking, hostname and service port.

Experimental spatial foveation retains center detail; gaze follows eye tracking unless headset manual center override is enabled. GPU defoveation restores the render extent; 4:4:4 is retained at encoded sample positions.
Loading this preset clears a previous desktop foveation override and restores client control.

expected_target_mbps.assumption: Equal eye dimensions and alpha at half eye height; aggregate target, not measured bandwidth.
